claims.statement: Tom Allen was matched to fight Tompkins Gilbert on October 29, 1877, in the London district, with £100 in stakes posted.
claims.excerpt: between Tompkins Gilbert, the champion of England, and Tom Allen, the champion of America. All the stakes, £100, have been posted

claims.statement: In September 1877 Tom Allen was described as the champion of America.
